const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Live controller for the one-shot Meta-World door-open service episode.
+
+The script deliberately uses only the standard service interface: camera images,
+camera calibration, target_pos, and robot proprioception.  No simulator state or
+reset API is used.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/records")
+
+
+def connect():
+    robot = Robot()
+    return robot, robot.spec()
+
+
+def send(robot, spec, actions, note, cameras=("front", "left", "right", "topview"), video="frames"):
+    actions = np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float64)
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "ee_delta", actions, dt=spec["control_dt"], interpolate="hold",
+        cameras=cameras, video_fps=8, video=video, include_depth=True, note=note,
+    )
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    call = result.meta.get("calls", "unknown")
+    result.save(str(OUT / f"call_{call:03}"))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "note": note,
+        "meta": result.meta,
+        "last_proprio": None if result.proprio is None else result.proprio[-1].tolist(),
+    }, indent=2))
+    return result
+
+
+def move_m(robot, spec, delta_m, grip, note):
+    """Move the mocap target by a world-frame displacement, at <=1 cm/step."""
+    delta_m = np.asarray(delta_m, dtype=np.float64)
+    steps = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta_m)) / 0.01)))
+    unit = delta_m / (steps * 0.01)
+    actions = np.tile(np.r_[unit, float(grip)], (steps, 1))
+    return send(robot, spec, actions, note)
+
+
+def repeated(robot, spec, action, steps, note):
+    return send(robot, spec, np.tile(np.asarray(action, dtype=np.float64), (steps, 1)), note)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    robot, spec = connect()
+    print(json.dumps({"spec": spec, "status": robot.status()}, indent=2))
+    stage = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "observe"
+    if stage == "approach":
+        # Move from the initial TCP toward the visibly identified T-handle.
+        move_m(robot, spec, [0.15, 0.085, 0.0], -1.0, "open-finger approach to door handle")
+        move_m(robot, spec, [0.055, 0.0, 0.0], -1.0, "align with outer half of handle")
+    elif stage == "observe":
+        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=list(spec["cameras"]), include_depth=True, video="frames")
+        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        obs.save(str(OUT / "observe"))
+        print(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
